description: This file defines a static class `AssetChildFlows` providing various asset-related operations within the data asset management system. It includes methods for creating, listing, updating, and retrieving asset child resources such as status logs, additional asset IDs, properties, mappings, reporting attributes, input parameters, control device mappings, EF source mappings, throughput equations and scalars, data input values, and parent input mappings, primarily following asset scope constraints and business rules.

classes.name: AssetChildFlows
classes.description: A static class providing asset resource management operations in the system.

methods.name: CreateAssetStatusLogAsync
methods.description: Creates an asset status log for a specified asset, validating existence and chronological order.

methods.name: ListAssetStatusLogsAsync
methods.description: Lists all status logs for a specified asset after verifying asset existence.

methods.name: GetAssetStatusLogByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a specific status log by id, ensuring it belongs to the asset.

methods.name: UpdateAssetStatusLogAsync
methods.description: Updates a status log entry, with validation for asset existence and chronological constraints.

methods.name: CreateAdditionalAssetIdAsync
methods.description: Creates an additional asset ID under an asset after verifying existence.

methods.name: ListAdditionalAssetIdsAsync
methods.description: Lists additional asset IDs for an asset, validating asset existence.

methods.name: GetAdditionalAssetIdByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves an additional asset ID by its id, scoped under an asset.

methods.name: UpdateAdditionalAssetIdAsync
methods.description: Updates an additional asset ID, scoped under an asset.

methods.name: CreateAssetPropertyAsync
methods.description: Creates an asset property under an asset.

methods.name: ListAssetPropertiesAsync
methods.description: Lists properties for an asset.

methods.name: GetAssetPropertyByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves an asset property by id.

methods.name: UpdateAssetPropertyAsync
methods.description: Updates an asset property by id.

methods.name: CreateControlDeviceMappingAsync
methods.description: Creates a control device mapping for an asset.

methods.name: ListControlDeviceMappingsAsync
methods.description: Lists control device mappings for an asset.

methods.name: GetControlDeviceMappingByIdAsync
methods.description: Gets a control device mapping by id.

methods.name: UpdateControlDeviceMappingAsync
methods.description: Updates a control device mapping by id.

methods.name: CreateInputParameterAsync
methods.description: Creates an input parameter for an asset.

methods.name: ListInputParametersAsync
methods.description: Lists input parameters for an asset.

methods.name: GetInputParameterByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves an input parameter by id.

methods.name: UpdateInputParameterAsync
methods.description: Updates an input parameter by id.

methods.name: CreateParentInputMappingAsync
methods.description: Creates a parent input mapping for a child input parameter, with validation for cycles and hierarchy.

methods.name: ListParentInputMappingsAsync
methods.description: Lists parent input mappings for a child input parameter.

methods.name: UpdateParentInputMappingAsync
methods.description: Updates a parent input mapping, with cycle prevention.

methods.name: CreateReportingAttributeMappingAsync
methods.description: Creates a reporting attribute mapping, enforcing uniqueness within the asset.

methods.name: ListReportingAttributeMappingsAsync
methods.description: Lists reporting attribute mappings.

methods.name: GetReportingAttributeMappingByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a reporting attribute mapping by id.

methods.name: UpdateReportingAttributeMappingAsync
methods.description: Updates a reporting attribute mapping, preventing duplicate attribute combinations.

methods.name: CreateEfSourceMappingAsync
methods.description: Creates an EF source mapping for an input parameter after validation.

methods.name: ListEfSourceMappingsAsync
methods.description: Lists EF source mappings, allowing empty list if input parameter not found under the asset.

methods.name: UpdateEfSourceMappingAsync
methods.description: Updates an EF source mapping after validations.

methods.name: CreateThroughputEquationAsync
methods.description: Creates a throughput equation, scoped to an input parameter.

methods.name: ListThroughputEquationsAsync
methods.description: Lists throughput equations.

methods.name: UpdateThroughputEquationAsync
methods.description: Updates a throughput equation.

methods.name: CreateThroughputScalarAsync
methods.description: Creates a throughput scalar for a specific throughput equation.

methods.name: ListThroughputScalarsAsync
methods.description: Lists throughput scalars for an input parameter and throughput equation.

methods.name: UpdateThroughputScalarAsync
methods.description: Updates a throughput scalar.

methods.name: CreateDataInputValueAsync
methods.description: Creates a data input value under an asset for a specific input parameter.

methods.name: ListDataInputValuesAsync
methods.description: Lists data input values.

methods.name: UpdateDataInputValueAsync
methods.description: Updates a data input value.
